causes.label: demand
causes.quote: combined demand across the two regions reached 10 265 MW at 4 pm. This extreme demand was the fifth highest for the summer to that time and was driven by temperatures in Melbourne and Adelaide of around 40 degrees

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Two units at Yallourn in Victoria and one at Northern power station in South Australia were out of service as a result of plant problems

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Two units at Yallourn in Victoria and one at Northern power station in South Australia were out of service as a result of plant problems

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: From 12.55 pm to 2.50 pm, NEMMCO invoked discretionary constraints to limit flows from Snowy into Victoria. Those constraints reduced import capability from Snowy, limiting flows into Victoria from around 1600 MW to 1100 MW

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: A combination of temperature driven high demands in both Victoria and South Australia, rebidding by International Power and the reduced availability of typically low priced capacity at TRU Energy's Yallourn and NRG Flinders' Northern power stations contributed to the price exceeding $5000/MWh
